mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES keeps rising from its recent trough while TRANSIT remains less negative, commuting intensity will recover and spill into lunch and impulse shopping. That should lift RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks relative to the prior four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved from -51.7 to -20.6 over the last three weekly means while TRANSIT improved from -53.9 to -43.6.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise above its prior 4-week mean even though WORKPLACES remains less negative for two consecutive weeks and TRANSIT does not re-weaken.

mechanism_narrative: A renewed drop in TRANSIT below its recent range signals tighter restrictions or lower public confidence, which reduces trips to shopping districts and pushes RETAIL_REC lower within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls below -50 and stays there for a weekly mean
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT was -53.9 at t-2w and remained deeply negative thereafter.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises or holds flat over the next 14 days after TRANSIT is below -50 for a weekly mean.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS and RESIDENTIAL both strengthen together, discretionary time shifts away from commercial outings and into local outdoor or at-home activity. This crowding-out effect should keep RETAIL_REC flat to lower over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS turned positive at t-2w and t-0w while RESIDENTIAL stayed above baseline every week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days despite PARKS remaining positive and RESIDENTIAL staying above baseline.

mechanism_narrative: A short-lived rebound in GROCERY_PHARM often accompanies pre-holiday stocking and indoor substitution, which can precede a dip in discretionary retail visits. If that rebound persists for one week, RETAIL_REC should soften over the next week.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM crosses from negative to positive on a weekly mean
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM moved from -1.0 at t-2w to 6.6 at t-3w, then stayed near/below baseline afterward.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases within 7 days after GROCERY_PHARM turns positive for a weekly mean.

mechanism_narrative: When WORKPLACES recovers faster than TRANSIT, more trips are redistributed to private or local modes rather than central retail corridors. That mode shift should suppress RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved sharply from -51.7 to -20.6 while TRANSIT stayed deeply negative around -44.7 to -53.9.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days even though WORKPLACES remains more recovered than TRANSIT.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in RESIDENTIAL from its recent elevated level implies people are spending less time at home and more time out of the house. That should translate into higher RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL falls at least 2 points week-on-week for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL stayed above baseline in all four weeks but dropped from 13.1 at t-2w to 7.1 at t-0w.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase within 14 days after RESIDENTIAL declines for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT remains deeply depressed while WORKPLACES only partially recovers, the city is likely under a mobility-constraining regime that limits discretionary trips. Under that regime, RETAIL_REC should decline relative to the last four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT stayed below -40 in every week and WORKPLACES stayed below -20 in every week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days while TRANSIT stays below -40 and WORKPLACES remains below -20.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rebound in PARKS and GROCERY_PHARM captures weekend errand and leisure substitution away from shopping centers. If both series stay above their recent averages, RETAIL_REC should be lower over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS turns positive while GROCERY_PHARM stays below 0 or above 0 for only one week
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS was positive at t-2w and t-0w; GROCERY_PHARM was near baseline to negative in the last three weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days despite concurrent strength in PARKS and GROCERY_PHARM.
